narrative: A Navya autonomous shuttle operating in Vienna's Seestadt pilot collided with a 30-year-old pedestrian at low speed. Wiener Linien said witnesses reported that the pedestrian, wearing headphones and looking at a phone, crossed into the side of the bus. The pedestrian was treated for minor scratches and the pilot was temporarily suspended while logs were reviewed.

automation: Automated bus trial; safety driver onboard
narrative: On the first day carrying passengers, an autonomous e-ATAK bus braked and was struck from behind by a tram in Gothenburg. A small number of passengers were onboard. Västtrafik reported no casualties or personal injuries; both vehicles sustained damage and the bus was removed from service for inspection.
